mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT `administrator_role`.`administrator_id`) FROM `db_iam_application_administrator_role` AS `administrator_role` INNER JOIN `db_iam_administrator` AS `administrator` ON `administrator`.`administrator_id` = `administrator_role`.`administrator_id` WHERE `administrator_role`.`role_id` = #{roleId} AND `administrator`.`status` = 1 AND `administrator`.`is_deleted` = 0
